question: The Waqf (Amendment) Bill 2025 amended which Act to address the issues and challenges related to the regulation and management of Waqf properties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Waqf Act, 1995**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Waqf Act, 1995** is the principal legislation governing the management, administration, and regulation of Waqf properties in India. It was enacted to ensure the proper use and protection of Waqf properties.
 
• The **Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025** seeks to amend the **Waqf Act, 1995** to address specific challenges faced in the regulation, management, and preservation of Waqf properties.
 
• The amendment aims to streamline administrative processes, improve transparency, and enhance the accountability of Waqf boards in managing Waqf assets. *Hence, the correct answer is The Waqf Act, 1995.*
 
• The amendment also focuses on safeguarding Waqf properties against encroachments and ensuring their utilization for the welfare of the community. <span style=&
